info.title: cy-performance API
info.description: Cycling analysis + training plan backend (read models, what-ifs, jobs).

get.description: Liveness probe (no DB access).
Athlete, season position, data version and last job runs.
Daily load and CTL/ATL/TSB (default: last 120 days).
Season skeleton with weekly targets projected from current fitness.
Last trends report (PMC agreement, CP fits, durability, TID, climbs, limiters).

schema.title: Response Get Trends V1 Trends Latest Get

post.description: Recompute and store the trends report (~100 ms).

schema.title: Response Recompute Trends V1 Trends Recompute Post

get.description: The persisted Explanation for ``key`` (e.g. ``ride:42``, ``readiness.2026-10-06``).
Glossary term ids (``docs/glossary/*.md``).

schema.title: Response List Glossary V1 Glossary Get

get.description: One glossary page as Markdown (zh-TW).
Newest first; filter by date range, sport, rides only, ride class.
Stored per-ride analysis with its Explanation.
Chart-ready streams (bucket-averaged; ≤ 5 000 points by default).
WORKOUT + RIDE.LOG text for a Strava description (deterministic; no poem).

post.description: Store the edited RIDE.LOG (e.g. with the acrostic poem); "" restores the generated one.
Preview (``confirm=false``) or write the ride's RIDE.LOG to Strava (flag-gated).

get.description: Post-ride RPE / feel: the web answer, else intervals.icu's.

post.description: Store post-ride RPE / feel; readiness is recomputed for the next day right away.

get.description: Whole weeks covering ``[start, end]`` (default: 4 weeks back, 2 ahead; max 63 days).
Current FTP, MMP, CP fits vs icu, estimate series and the (never applied) proposal.

post.description: Same as ``GET /ftp`` but evaluated against another FTP setting (nothing stored).
Record the athlete's FTP decision (manual settings row; icu is not changed).

get.description: Stored verdicts (default: last 28 days).
Stored verdict, or computed on the fly when none is stored.

post.description: Score and store the given days (default: today).

schema.title: Response Recompute V1 Readiness Recompute Post

get.description: Stored proposals (what the calendar will get), rendered with steps and workout text.

post.description: What-if plan (availability, days off, indoor days, readiness, bias, CTL); nothing stored.
Replan and store proposals (never writes to intervals.icu); 409 while a run is active.

get.description: Stored report stems, newest first (``2026-10-06`` / ``2026-W41``).

schema.title: Response List Reports V1 Reports  Kind  Get

post.description: Render (and store) the report for ``day`` (default today / this week).

get.description: Markdown + structured facts of one report.

post.description: Queue a job (one runs at a time); poll ``GET /jobs/{id}``.

get.description: This profile's jobs started by this server process.

schema.title: Response List Jobs V1 Jobs Get

get.description: Status / result of one job.
Every profile with its mode, last run and whether the UI may write its calendar.

schema.title: Response List Profiles V1 Profiles Get

post.description: Queue this profile's morning run; poll ``GET /v1/jobs/{id}`` for the report.

get.description: Saved run reports (scheduled and manual), newest first.

schema.title: Response Runs V1 Autopilot Runs Get

FitnessPoint.description: One day of the performance-management chart.

FtpAccept.title: FtpAccept
FtpAccept.description: Request body of ``POST /v1/ftp/accept`` (the athlete's explicit decision).

FtpProposalOut.title: FtpProposalOut
FtpProposalOut.description: A suggested FTP change — never applied automatically.

Meta.title: Meta
Meta.description: ``GET /v1/meta``: everything the app shell needs on load.

MethodRef.description: Which model/algorithm produced the result, with the inputs actually used.

date_minutes.title: Date Minutes
date_minutes.description: Cap minutes on dates; 0 = day off

PlanStep.title: PlanStep
PlanStep.description: A rendered workout step (for the workout-profile chart).

PowerWindow.title: PowerWindow
PowerWindow.description: Mean-maximal power + fits for one window.

ReadinessComponentOut.title: ReadinessComponentOut
ReadinessComponentOut.description: One weighted input of the readiness score.

Reason.title: Reason
Reason.description: One factor behind a conclusion, most important first in ``Explanation.because``.

RideFeedbackOut.title: RideFeedbackOut
RideFeedbackOut.description: Answers for a ride and where they came from (``web`` / ``intervals.icu`` / ``none``).

RideLogSave.description: ``POST /v1/activities/{id}/ride-log``: store an edited text ("" = back to generated).

SeasonWeekOut.title: SeasonWeekOut
SeasonWeekOut.description: One week of the season overview.

StravaDescriptionOut.title: StravaDescriptionOut
StravaDescriptionOut.description: Result of a preview or a write.

WeekTargetOut.title: WeekTargetOut
WeekTargetOut.description: Load target of one season week.
